messages:
Alex: Heads up — PR #8123 (improve batch scheduling) is ready for merge but CI is flaky on GPU runners. We have a deploy freeze from 10:00–11:00 PST. Can we coordinate a merge window before the freeze? @Maria @Jamal

Maria: Thanks. Can you paste the failing CI job logs? Is it consistently failing or intermittent?

Jamal: It fails intermittently on `ubuntu-22.04-gpu-3` with CUDA OOM in the integration tests. Looks like a tester VM regen issue, not code. Re-running usually helps.

Alex: Repro log snippet: ```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory while allocating 1.2 GiB
  at tests/integration/test_batching.py:48
```

CI-Bot: build #8123.3 failed - ubuntu-22.04-gpu-3 (OOM). Retry available: `ci retry`

Alex: Plan: wait for a clean CI run and merge right before the freeze window opens. Preferable merge time 09:40–09:55 PST so can rollback before 10:00 if anything weird. Thoughts?

Sandro: Small change, LGTM from product. If CI is green I'm fine with merging at 09:45. :+1:

Dmitri: I can do a quick smoke test after merge. Would prefer merge at 09:50 to give time for final checks.

Maria: If Jamal can trigger rerun and monitor the GPU job, we should be good. Also we should avoid rebasing during the freeze window — let's set a rebase window 08:30–09:30 PST to catch integration drift.

Jamal: Rerunning now: `ci retry --job ubuntu-22.04-gpu-3 --build 8123`. Will ping here when it finishes.

CI-Bot: build #8123.4 passed - all checks green. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/8123/4

Jamal: Passed. I'm watching the runner for flakiness. No other queued merges.

Alex: Great. I'll hold off on rebases until after 09:30. Who is merging? @Jamal volunteered before — want to take it at 09:45?

Jamal: I can merge at 09:45 and stay on watch for 30m. Command I'll run: `git checkout main && git pull && git merge --no-ff 8123 && git push origin main` then kick off smoke tests.

Dmitri: I'll run smoke tests immediately after merge and post results here.

Sandro: :shipit: thanks all.

Alex: Final: merge scheduled 09:45 PST. If anything fails, revert procedure: `git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>` and notify #eng-oncall.

Jamal: Merged at 09:45. Merge commit `a3f4d2b`. Starting smoke tests.

CI-Bot: deploy pipeline started for `main` at 09:47 PST.

Dmitri: Smoke tests OK, no errors in the first 15m. All looks healthy.

Alex: Thanks team — closing the loop. We'll keep the rebase window policy documented in the PR checklist.
